signals.title: Codex stops treating Git commands as inherently safe
signals.title_zh: Codex 不再把 Git 命令默认视为安全操作
signals.summary: Codex removed Git commands from its known-safe classification because repository configuration can make even read-only Git commands execute helpers. Under the unless-trusted policy, commands such as git status now require approval unless an explicit execution-policy rule allows them.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Git 命令移出默认安全分类，因为仓库配置可能让看似只读的 Git 命令执行 helper。在 unless-trusted 策略下，git status 等命令现在也需要审批，除非有明确执行策略放行。

signals.title: Codex isolates automatic plugin Git operations from project Git configuration
signals.title_zh: Codex 将自动插件 Git 操作与项目 Git 配置隔离
signals.summary: Automatic marketplace upgrades, plugin cache refreshes and curated lookups now strip repository-scoped Git environment variables and run from a temporary trusted repository, preventing project-local Git configuration from redirecting remotes or invoking helpers during background operations.
signals.summary_zh: 自动 Marketplace 升级、插件缓存刷新与精选来源查询现在会移除仓库级 Git 环境变量，并在临时可信仓库中运行，避免后台操作继承项目本地 Git 配置后重定向远端或执行 helper。

signals.title: Codex persists thread section moves before the first turn
signals.title_zh: Codex 在首轮对话前持久化线程分区移动
signals.summary: A newly created non-ephemeral thread is now materialized and flushed before an explicit section move, so a thread with no first turn or preview is still represented in section-filtered queries instead of disappearing from durable navigation state.
signals.summary_zh: 新建的非临时线程现在会在显式移动分区前先物化并落盘，因此即使尚无首轮消息或预览，也能在按分区筛选的查询中保持可见，不再从持久导航状态中消失。

signals.title: Claude Code adds one-shot idle notifications for cross-session messaging
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 为跨会话消息增加一次性空闲通知
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.236 adds notify_when_idle to cross-session SendMessage, allowing another local session to send one notice when it next becomes idle. The mechanism is opt-in, one-shot and explicitly avoids polling.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.236 在跨会话 SendMessage 中加入 notify_when_idle，可让另一会话在下一次进入空闲时发送一次通知；该机制需显式启用、只触发一次，并明确避免轮询。

signals.title: Claude Code makes wildcard read-deny rules dominate allowed read regions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让通配读拒绝规则优先于允许读取区域
signals.summary: On macOS, wildcard read-deny rules now take precedence even inside allowed read regions, cover the contents of matched directories, and cannot be bypassed by renaming a denied file.
signals.summary_zh: 在 macOS 上，通配读拒绝规则现在即使位于允许读取区域内也具有更高优先级，同时覆盖匹配目录的内容，并阻止通过重命名被拒文件来绕过限制。

signals.title: Claude Code serializes runner reuse behind post-session hooks
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将 Runner 复用串行化到会话后置 Hook 完成之后
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.236 fixes self-hosted runner sessions released on idle, retirement or startup timeout from occasionally resuming on another runner before the previous post-session hook had completed.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.236 修复了自托管 Runner 会话在空闲释放、退役或启动超时后，偶尔会在上一轮 post-session Hook 尚未完成时就在另一 Runner 上恢复的问题。

signals.title: Claude Code performs inbox-capacity admission before cross-session SendMessage
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在跨会话 SendMessage 前执行收件箱容量准入
signals.summary: SendMessage now rejects additional messages up front when a rapid burst would exceed the target session inbox capacity, instead of acknowledging them as sent and then dropping them.
signals.summary_zh: 当快速突发消息将超过目标会话收件箱容量时，SendMessage 现在会在发送前直接拒绝，而不是先报告发送成功再静默丢弃。

signals.title: Gemini CLI preserves tool or media turns even when their text is empty
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在文本为空时仍保留包含工具或媒体的轮次
signals.summary: Gemini CLI fixes history handling so turns with empty text are not discarded when they still contain tool or media content, preserving non-text execution evidence in conversation state.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 修复历史记录处理：当轮次文本为空但仍包含工具调用或媒体内容时不再丢弃，从而在会话状态中保留非文本执行证据。

signals.title: Google ADK stops RemoteA2aAgent from replaying credential requests to peers
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止 RemoteA2aAgent 向远端 Peer 重放凭据请求
signals.summary: ADK found that session-history reconstruction could forward adk_request_credential function calls containing serialized AuthConfig, including OAuth client secrets or service-account keys, to a remote A2A peer. Credential-bearing function calls are now stripped before the message is rendered or forwarded.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 发现会话历史重建可能把包含序列化 AuthConfig 的 adk_request_credential 函数调用转发给远端 A2A Peer，其中可能包含 OAuth 客户端密钥或服务账号密钥。现在会在渲染或转发前剔除携带凭据的函数调用。

signals.title: Google ADK keys MCP agent-server conversation state to the connection
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 MCP Agent Server 会话状态绑定到连接
signals.summary: ADK changed its MCP agent-server session map to key conversation state by connection. With MCP SDK 2.x, a fresh ServerSession can be created per request; keying by that object silently restarted the conversation on every tool call. The new connection key preserves one conversation per connection while avoiding cross-client state sharing.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 将 MCP Agent Server 的会话映射改为按连接绑定对话状态。MCP SDK 2.x 可能为每个请求创建新的 ServerSession，原先按该对象索引会让每次工具调用都静默开启新对话；新的连接键既保持同一连接上的对话连续性，又避免不同客户端共享状态。

signals.title: Google ADK publishes file artifact versions atomically
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 以原子方式发布文件 Artifact 版本
signals.summary: FileArtifactService now reserves a hidden pending directory, writes payload and metadata there, and exposes the version with one atomic rename. Concurrent or interrupted saves no longer make a partial directory appear as the latest valid artifact; the change explicitly documents remaining power-loss durability limits.
signals.summary_zh: FileArtifactService 现在先保留隐藏 pending 目录，在其中写入 payload 与 metadata，再通过一次原子重命名发布版本。并发或中断保存不再让半成品目录成为“最新有效 Artifact”，同时实现明确记录了断电场景仍存在的持久性边界。

signals.title: Google ADK removes an indefinite-wait failure mode from local code execution
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 消除本地代码执行的一类无限等待故障
signals.summary: UnsafeLocalCodeExecutor now runs code in a plain child interpreter and derives the result from exit status and pipes instead of waiting on a multiprocessing result queue. A child that dies without reporting no longer leaves the agent waiting forever, while trivial execution latency is reported to drop from about 2.3 seconds to about 35 milliseconds.
signals.summary_zh: UnsafeLocalCodeExecutor 改为在普通子解释器中运行代码，并从退出状态与管道得到结果，而不是等待 multiprocessing 结果队列。子进程即使异常退出且未写回结果，也不再让 Agent 永久等待；提交同时报告简单程序延迟约从 2.3 秒降至 35 毫秒。

signals.title: Google ADK resumes workflow-node authentication from the node's own auth configuration
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 从节点自身认证配置恢复 Workflow Node 认证
signals.summary: ADK fixes workflow resume so a node recovers authentication from that node's own auth configuration rather than relying on a mismatched surrounding authentication state.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复 Workflow 恢复逻辑，使节点从自身的认证配置恢复认证，而不是依赖可能不匹配的外围认证状态。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds MCP session-pool growth without closing in-flight calls
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在不关闭进行中调用的前提下限制 MCP Session Pool 增长
signals.summary: ADK adds a 15-minute idle TTL to pooled MCP sessions and evicts stale sessions on pool access, addressing unbounded growth as per-user credentials rotate. Sessions with calls in flight are pinned out of the sweep, stale-use pins are surfaced by warnings, and teardown runs asynchronously so unrelated callers are not parked behind dead sessions.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 为池化 MCP 会话加入 15 分钟空闲 TTL，并在访问 Session Pool 时淘汰过期会话，以解决用户凭据轮换导致的无界增长。进行中的调用会被固定并排除在清理之外，异常长的固定状态会产生告警，清理则异步进行，避免无关调用被死会话阻塞。
